Zinc is an essential trace mineral and a vital cofactor for over 300 enzymatic reactions in the body, regulating immune cell activity, dermal tissue repair, hair follicle stability, and testosterone production. The 20mg clinical potency corrects nutritional deficiencies safely, avoiding the stomach discomfort and copper depletion often caused by excessive 50mg doses.

highlights: Strengthens Immune Defense: Essential for the activation of T-lymphocytes and natural killer cells, helping reduce the duration of seasonal colds

products.directions:
Take 1 tablet daily with a glass of water.
• For Maximum Absorption: Take on an empty stomach (1 hour before or 2 hours after meals).
• For Sensitive Stomachs: If mild stomach sensitivity occurs, take alongside a meal (avoiding dairy).
• Keep a 2-hour window away from iron supplements, calcium tablets, or caffeine, as they can reduce zinc absorption.
products.warnings: Dietary supplement only. Do not exceed 1 tablet per day. Long-term use of zinc without copper should be limited to 3–6 months continuous cycles. If taking antibiotics (Quinolones or Tetracyclines), take at least 4 hours apart. Store below 30°C in a dry place. Keep bottle tightly closed.
whoIsItFor: Athletes looking to optimize natural testosterone synthesis and recovery
Individuals dealing with seasonal immune stress or slow wound healing
Anyone suffering from telogen effluvium hair shedding and skin blemishes

faqs.question: Why is this formula 20mg instead of 50mg?
faqs.answer: The body's daily requirement is 11mg, with an upper limit of 40mg. Daily doses of 50mg often cause nausea and can lead to copper deficiency. A 20mg dose provides effective support safely for daily long-term use.

faqs.question: Can this help with hair loss?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zinc deficiency is a recognized cause of diffuse hair shedding (Telogen Effluvium). Supplementing with zinc helps restore normal cellular turnover in the hair follicle.

faqs.question: Can I take Zinc together with my Multivitamin?
faqs.answer: If your multivitamin already provides 15mg of zinc, you do not need to take a separate zinc supplement at the same time unless recommended by a healthcare professional.
